audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[].side read "Skill" on all seven rows while the content layer win[] and the packet levelChart both read Mel/Mel/Skill/Skill/Ekko/Ekko/Ekko — the page renders two different answers to who wins each stage.
audit.why: Mel's Radiant Volley reaches 950 and cycles 10s at rank 1 while Ekko's Q is 9s and his E dash is only 325 range, so she owns levels 1-2; Chronobreak (110s) flips the lane at 6 and Ekko's 57.65% win rate over 902 games confirms the late-lane ownership.
audit.corrected: phases[0..1].side = Mel, phases[2..3].side = Skill, phases[4..6].side = Ekko, matching win[] and the packet chart; whys rewritten to match each verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text described a "beam" and a "reflect passive" — Mel has neither. Rebuttal is her W; Searing Brilliance is the passive and it is an Overwhelm-stacking execute, not a shield.
audit.why: enemyKit: W Rebuttal 38/35/33/29/26s barrier that reflects projectiles; P Searing Brilliance stacks Overwhelm and executes; R Golden Eclipse 120/100/80s detonates Overwhelm at any distance.
audit.corrected: Spikes now name Radiant Volley's 10s cycle, Rebuttal's 38s rank-1 cooldown, Chronobreak's 110s rewind, and the flank angle that turns Rebuttal the wrong way.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: both Ekko's Q (Timewinder) and W (Parallel Convergence) are flagged projectile, so Rebuttal reflects them back at him. Nothing on the page said which of his spells the barrier eats.
audit.why: ownerKit Q and W both carry the projectile flag; enemyKit W text: reflects enemy projectiles back at the attacker and prevents her from taking damage.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns, dos and trading now state: hold Q and W while Rebuttal glows, commit in its 38s gap; E is a 325-range dash and is not reflected.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: It is the field that carries real cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Now carries Rebuttal 38s->26s, Radiant Volley 10s->6s, Chronobreak 110s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Neither missingInteractions item was on the page: Overwhelm's execute threshold, and the passive's bonus-projectile auto wind-up as the burst tell.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[2].d now tells you to track the HP number rather than the bar, and notes Golden Eclipse reaches from anywhere.

edits.before: Mel's ranged poke and damage-reflecting passive make early trades expensive for you, since dashing in with E to auto-reset just feeds free damage back onto you. Play a patient farming lane through levels 1-2, using minion bodies to block her line and only stepping up to last-hit when her poke is on cooldown. Levels 3-5 are still tilted her way — she out-ranges your entire early kit and her reflect makes short trades a loss even when you land Q. Hold your all-in ambitions until you have level 6 and real item damage.
edits.after: Mel's Radiant Volley (10s at rank 1) and Rebuttal's reflect make early trades expensive for you, since dashing in with E to auto-reset just feeds free damage back onto you. Play a patient farming lane through levels 1-2, using minion bodies to block her line and only stepping up to last-hit while Radiant Volley is on cooldown. Levels 3-5 are still tilted her way — she out-ranges your whole early kit at 950 and Rebuttal reflects the Q you open with. Hold your all-in ambitions until level 6, when Chronobreak covers the commit.

notes: Chart was cross-layer split: full phases[].side read 'Skill' on all seven rows while content win[] already read Mel/Mel/Skill/Skill/Ekko/Ekko/Ekko, matching the packet levelChart. I moved the full layer onto the content layer's values and rewrote every why I flipped, so no win[N] edit was needed — win[] already held the correct token and a no-op edit is not proposable. Verify at apply time that the pairing check accepts this direction. Ekko's Q and W both carry the projectile flag, so Rebuttal reflects both; E is a 325-range dash and is not a projectile. Rebuttal's mana cost falls to 0 at rank 5, so it is free late — worth knowing but it did not fit any field at length. Template sweep: breakdown.carry, breakdown.late, breakdown.feeding, ahead and breakdown.spikes all read as name-swappable templates, but Mel's kit gave me nothing specific enough to ground them at the same length without inventing, so I left them. Ability names Searing Brilliance / Radiant Volley / Rebuttal / Solar Snare / Golden Eclipse verified against the packet's enemyAbilities map.
